lessons.titleZh: 被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣

brief.meaningEn: Feel emotionally burdened by demanding schoolwork or expectations.
brief.meaningZh: 因功課或成績期望而感到沉重壓力。
brief.grammar: Someone is/feels weighed down by academic pressure. The broader reusable frame is weighed down by + a burden; the source specifies academic pressure.
brief.register: Everyday school and wellbeing discussion; a class adviser notices a pupil struggling with overlapping deadlines.
brief.boundaryZh: 描述壓力造成負擔；不等於學生能力差，也不表示壓力必然來自某個人。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是書包重量，也不能只憑課程繁忙就假設每位學生都感到被壓垮。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據作業、期望與學生感受，指出壓力來源而不作無根據的診斷。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 184, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Some students feel weighed down by academic pressure.

listening.en: Three major projects fall due on the same Friday. Mei says she cannot relax even after studying all evening and feels weighed down by academic pressure.
listening.zh: 三份重要專題都在同一個星期五到期。美整晚溫習後仍不能放鬆，說自己被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣。
listening.promptZh: weighed down by academic pressure 指甚麼？

options.en: Mei feels burdened by school demands.
options.zh: 美感到學業要求帶來沉重負擔。

options.en: Mei feels ready because the projects are spread across the term.
options.zh: 專題分散在整個學期，美因而覺得準備充足。

options.en: The projects are complete, so no deadline remains.
options.zh: 專題已全部完成，因此沒有剩餘限期。

options.en: Mei is asking for more projects because she feels unstretched.
options.zh: 美覺得工作量不足，正要求增加專題。

listening.explanationZh: 同一日多項限期及難以放鬆，說明心理負擔。

reply.promptEn: Why is Jun asking for a planning meeting? He has two exams and a presentation next week, and he says the demands are making it hard to sleep.
reply.promptZh: （俊為何要求開會規劃？他下週有兩場考試及一次匯報，說這些要求令他難以入睡。）

options.en: His school demands feel heavy right now.
options.zh: 目前學業要求令他感到沉重。

options.en: He wants help organising overlapping tasks.
options.zh: 他想有人協助安排重疊的工作。

options.en: He feels weighed down by academic pressure.
options.zh: 他被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣。

options.en: The deadlines are affecting his rest.
options.zh: 限期正影響他的休息。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都根據任務與睡眠困難作出合理回應。

scene.promptZh: 一名學生說，連續測驗及家人對成績的期望令她長期緊張。哪句最貼切？

options.en: She is weighed down by academic pressure.
options.zh: 她被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣。

options.en: She describes the tests as challenging but says they cause no tension.
options.zh: 她說測驗有挑戰，但不會令她緊張。

options.en: She is anxious only because she has no school tasks to do.
options.zh: 她焦慮純因沒有學業任務。

scene.explanationZh: 考試與成績期望構成她明確說出的負擔。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項不足以斷定某學生 weighed down by academic pressure？

options.en: The student says deadlines leave her unable to rest.
options.zh: 學生說限期令她無法休息。

options.en: A school has many assignments, but this student says nothing about feeling burdened.
options.zh: 學校功課很多，但這名學生沒有說自己感到負擔。

options.en: The student reports worry about exams and asks for support.
options.zh: 學生說擔心考試，並尋求支援。

contrast.explanationZh: 要描述個人的感受，不能單憑課程安排推斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 有人說：「這句話代表這個學生不夠聰明。」哪句回應最準確？

options.en: Being weighed down by academic pressure says nothing about the student’s ability.
options.zh: 被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣，並不能說明學生能力。

options.en: It proves the student cannot learn.
options.zh: 它證明學生無法學習。

options.en: It tells us that the student has already failed every assessment.
options.zh: 這表示學生已在所有考核中失敗。

dialogue.explanationZh: 壓力與能力不能畫上等號。

speaking.en: Lina feels weighed down by academic pressure because four coursework deadlines overlap, so she asks her tutor to help set priorities.
speaking.zh: 四項課業限期重疊，令莉娜被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣，因此她請導師協助分先後次序。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出她請導師幫忙做甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：阿樂要在十天內交兩份報告並準備一場公開考試；他說自己一直焦慮，導師同意與他訂優先次序。用英文描述他的感受與支援，不要說他必然考試失敗。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出十天內兩份報告與一場考試、他表示焦慮、導師協助訂優先次序；不推斷考試結果。

examples.en: With two reports and an exam in ten days, Lok feels weighed down by academic pressure; his tutor will help him set priorities.
examples.zh: 十天內要交兩份報告並應考，樂被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣；導師會協助他訂優先次序。

examples.en: Lok says he feels weighed down by academic pressure as he prepares two reports and an exam over the next ten days, so his tutor has offered a planning meeting to set priorities.
examples.zh: 樂說未來十天要準備兩份報告和一場考試，令他被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣；導師於是提議開會，協助他訂出優先次序。

takeaways.en: Weighed down by academic pressure describes a felt burden from school demands.
takeaways.zh: 被學業壓力壓得喘不過氣，描述學業要求帶來的沉重感。

takeaways.en: Feeling weighed down by academic pressure does not measure a learner’s ability.
takeaways.zh: 感到學業壓力沉重，並不能用來判斷學生能力。

brief.meaningEn: Release or reduce the tension one feels, often through an activity or change of pace.
brief.meaningZh: 透過活動或轉換節奏，紓解身上的緊張感。
brief.grammar: Shake the stress off: shake + the stress + off. The phrase describes easing felt tension, not necessarily solving its cause.
brief.register: Informal wellbeing conversation; a rehearsal partner explains why a short walk helps before a performance.
brief.boundaryZh: 紓壓不等於責任已完成、問題已解決或壓力永不回來。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是把壓力當成實物抖落，也不表示每種活動對每人都同樣有效。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分清暫時紓解感受與處理壓力來源。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 184, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A short run helps me shake the stress off.

listening.en: Before her first debate, Tara felt tense. She took a quiet walk around the garden to shake the stress off, then returned to practise her opening.
listening.zh: 第一次辯論前，塔拉很緊張。她在花園靜靜走了一圈，想甩掉壓力，然後回來練習開場白。
listening.promptZh: shake the stress off 表示甚麼？

options.en: Ease the tension she feels.
options.zh: 紓解她感受到的緊張。

options.en: She means the debate no longer needs any preparation.
options.zh: 她的意思是辯論已不用準備。

options.en: The walk removed the debate from the schedule.
options.zh: 散步使辯論從日程中取消。

options.en: She expects the walk to guarantee a confident performance.
options.zh: 她預期散步保證演出時有自信。

listening.explanationZh: 散步旨在減輕緊張，不代表辯論取消或必定勝出。

reply.promptEn: Why is Bo going outside before the audition? She says she is tense and a few minutes of fresh air usually helps her settle, though she still has to audition.
reply.promptZh: （寶為何在試演前到外面？她說自己很緊張，呼吸幾分鐘新鮮空氣通常能使她平靜些；她仍須參加試演。）

options.en: She wants to feel calmer before going in.
options.zh: 她希望進場前冷靜一點。

options.en: Fresh air may ease her tension for now.
options.zh: 新鮮空氣或可暫時緩解緊張。

options.en: She is trying to shake the stress off.
options.zh: 她想甩掉壓力。

options.en: She is taking a short pause, then returning to audition.
options.zh: 她稍作休息，然後回去試演。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都與暫時減輕緊張且仍需試演的情境相符。

scene.promptZh: 面試前，應徵者做了幾分鐘呼吸練習，感到較平靜，但面試仍在前面。哪句貼切？

options.en: She tried to shake the stress off.
options.zh: 她試着甩掉壓力。

options.en: She has finished the interview, so she has nothing to face.
options.zh: 她已完成面試，毋須再面對它。

options.en: The breathing exercises remove the need to attend.
options.zh: 呼吸練習使她不用參加面試。

scene.explanationZh: 呼吸練習讓她紓解感受，而未消除面試本身。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種解讀最超出 shake the stress off 的意思？

options.en: A short break can make someone feel less tense.
options.zh: 短暫休息可使人較不緊張。

options.en: The underlying problem has been permanently solved.
options.zh: 壓力來源已永久解決。

options.en: Movement can sometimes help a person settle.
options.zh: 活動身體有時能幫助人平靜。

contrast.explanationZh: 紓壓不保證根本問題得到永久解決。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「只要 shake the stress off，就不用再準備演講。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: You can shake the stress off and still need to prepare the speech.
options.zh: 你可以甩掉壓力，但仍須準備演講。

options.en: The phrase means the speech is cancelled.
options.zh: 這片語表示演講取消。

options.en: Feeling calmer automatically completes the speech preparation.
options.zh: 平靜下來就會自動完成演講準備。

dialogue.explanationZh: 感覺減壓與完成準備是兩回事。

speaking.en: A short stretch helped the dancers shake the stress off before rehearsal, but they still checked the difficult steps.
speaking.zh: 簡短伸展幫助舞蹈員在排練前甩掉壓力，但他們仍檢查了困難舞步。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出舞蹈員紓壓後仍做甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：露絲明天須主持公開問答，今晚因緊張而暫停準備，跟朋友慢走十五分鐘後比較平靜，再回來檢查題卡。用英文交代紓壓與仍需準備。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出明天主持、十五分鐘慢走後較平靜、回來檢查題卡；勿說問題已永久消失。

examples.en: Ruth took a fifteen-minute walk with a friend to shake the stress off before tomorrow’s public Q&A; calmer afterward, she returned to check her question cards.
examples.zh: 露絲明天要主持公開問答，她跟朋友慢走十五分鐘以甩掉壓力；之後較平靜，便回來檢查題卡。

examples.en: Ahead of tomorrow’s public Q&A, Ruth paused her preparation for a fifteen-minute walk with a friend. It helped her shake the stress off, and she still checked the question cards afterward.
examples.zh: 明天要主持公開問答，露絲暫停準備，跟朋友慢走十五分鐘。這幫助她甩掉壓力，之後她仍檢查了題卡。

takeaways.en: Shake the stress off means ease felt tension for now.
takeaways.zh: 甩掉壓力，指暫時紓解緊張感。

takeaways.en: You can shake the stress off and still need to prepare.
takeaways.zh: 你可以甩掉壓力，但仍須準備。

brief.meaningEn: Help someone develop qualities such as patience, responsibility or resilience through experience.
brief.meaningZh: 透過經歷培養耐性、責任感或韌性等品格。
brief.grammar: An experience can build character; this is a claim about development, not an automatic result. Built character is the past form when needed.
brief.register: Everyday education discussion; a volunteer coordinator explains a specific responsibility students learned by managing an event.
brief.boundaryZh: 要指出哪種品格及怎樣培養；不能聲稱任何困難或運動必然有益。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是塑造故事人物，也不等於吃苦本身一定正當或有效。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據具體行動和反思，說明經歷如何培養一項品格。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 184, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.

listening.en: The junior organisers had to apologise for a cancelled workshop and arrange refunds themselves. Their mentor said taking responsibility in that way could build character.
listening.zh: 初級主辦者要為取消工作坊道歉，並親自安排退款。導師說，這樣承擔責任可以磨練品格。
listening.promptZh: build character 在這裏指甚麼？

options.en: Develop responsibility through the experience.
options.zh: 透過經歷培養責任感。

options.en: The mentor thinks refunds were unnecessary, so the team should avoid them.
options.zh: 導師認為毋須退款，團隊應避開這事。

options.en: The organisers developed skills only by avoiding the cancellation.
options.zh: 主辦者只靠逃避處理取消活動來培養能力。

options.en: The mentor says responsibility is guaranteed by any hardship.
options.zh: 導師說任何困難都必然帶來責任感。

listening.explanationZh: 親自道歉與退款，提供培養責任感的具體方式。

reply.promptEn: Why does the coach ask captains to admit a scoring error to both teams? They correct the result, then discuss how honest decisions earn trust.
reply.promptZh: （教練為何要求隊長向兩隊承認記分錯誤？他們更正賽果，再討論誠實決定如何建立信任。）

options.en: The captains practise honesty and responsibility.
options.zh: 隊長練習誠實和負責。

options.en: Correcting the error can teach a useful habit.
options.zh: 更正錯誤可以培養有用習慣。

options.en: Owning the mistake may build character.
options.zh: 承認錯誤可能有助磨練品格。

options.en: The discussion links their action to trust.
options.zh: 討論把他們的行動與信任連起來。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指向誠實承認錯誤的具體學習。

scene.promptZh: 學生輪流管理社區書櫃，漏登記時會主動補正並告知借閱者。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The experience may build character by teaching responsibility.
options.zh: 這經歷可能透過培養責任感來磨練品格。

options.en: The students will automatically behave perfectly after one correction.
options.zh: 學生一次更正後必定永遠表現完美。

options.en: The record-keeping task matters only because it is difficult.
options.zh: 紀錄工作有用，只因它困難。

scene.explanationZh: 主動補正錯誤是責任感的可見例子。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句對 build character 最謹慎？

options.en: Any punishment automatically builds character.
options.zh: 任何懲罰都自動磨練品格。

options.en: A supported challenge may build character if learners practise patience and reflect on it.
options.zh: 有支援的挑戰若讓學生練習耐性並反思，可能磨練品格。

options.en: Difficulty alone proves someone has developed responsibility.
options.zh: 單是遇到困難就證明已培養責任感。

contrast.explanationZh: 須有具體行動與反思，不能把困難自動視為益處。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「build character 是創作小說角色。」這段社區活動中應怎樣理解？

options.en: Here, build character means develop responsibility through what students do.
options.zh: 這裏磨練品格，指透過學生的行動培養責任感。

options.en: Any demanding task develops responsibility even without reflection.
options.zh: 任何艱難任務即使沒有反思也能培養責任感。

options.en: It means making every task harder without reason.
options.zh: 它指無故令每項工作更難。

dialogue.explanationZh: 此處 character 指品格，不是故事角色。

speaking.en: Helping newcomers practise the safety rules may build character if the older students learn patience and listen to questions.
speaking.zh: 高年級學生協助新生練習安全規則，若在過程中學會耐心聆聽提問，便可能磨練品格。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出學生可能培養哪種品格。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生負責為社區餐食活動記錄過敏資訊；發現遺漏後主動更正，並向導師請教往後如何避免。用英文說明這經歷可能培養責任感，不要保證人人都會改變。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出過敏資訊紀錄、發現遺漏後主動更正、請教避免方法，以及可能培養責任感。

examples.en: Recording allergy details for the community meal and correcting an omission may build character: the students took responsibility and asked their tutor how to prevent another error.
examples.zh: 學生為社區餐食記錄過敏資訊，發現遺漏後更正，這可能磨練品格：他們承擔責任，並請教導師如何避免再犯。

examples.en: The students corrected a missing allergy note in the meal records and sought their tutor’s advice. That responsible response could build character, though it does not guarantee everyone will change.
examples.zh: 學生更正了餐食紀錄中遺漏的過敏資訊，並向導師請教。這種負責任的回應可能磨練品格，但不保證每個人都會改變。

takeaways.en: Build character can mean developing good qualities through specific actions.
takeaways.zh: 磨練品格，可指透過具體行動培養良好特質。

takeaways.en: A challenge may build character, but hardship alone proves nothing.
takeaways.zh: 挑戰可能磨練品格，單是吃苦卻不能證明甚麼。
